checkpoint: Shared tombstone removal introduces a read/install race and cannot distinguish a later authoritative cancellation on the same provisional identity using the frozen store. Choose the earlier R3 president's explicitly permitted alternative: released refusals persist only official IDs; authoritative provisional rejections never get deleted for retry. This is author preparation, not a new president ruling. Published-doc refinement and added SL-4 contract path require fresh full review; no DATA/fence schema or public handle change.

dispositions.decision: Any shared provisional rejection refuses before POST even with local proof. A local rejection without released-refusal proof also refuses. Keep all state/fences unchanged, typed nonretryable failure, new key required. If finite proof capacity is unavailable, keep original failure protected rather than release its key. Controls seed legacy status-refusal tombstones and authoritative denied:true/malformed2xx/completed-cancellation identities; no-proof replacement yields zero POST/unchanged active state. R3 positive retry matrix uses the proposed official-only persistence rule; no shared deletion.

Eliminate shared deletion for retry. Read/install authoritative state inside the same exclusive lease callback on refresh and stream-open. Serializing-lease gated getSessionInfo/readHistory/stream-open controls cannot install stale state across current dispatch checks; preserve correlated delivery/exact POST count. A newer cancellation or closure while retry waits refuses with zero retry effects, including completed cancellation despite retained local refusal proof.

Rollback provisional active registration even when required rejection persistence read/write fails. Keep local tombstones and bounded same-key protected typed fence-store failure; no released proof, no automatic replay. Inject required write failure for403 with official identity/post-binding4xx and authoritative cached denial/malformed2xx. One POST, no stuck active turn, otherwise admissible distinct-key work; same-key repeat preserves failure and zero additional POST.

Restore only proven local/stream provisional state after current shared/cancellation/closure/admission checks under the lease, immediately before dispatch. No shared deletion; admission refusal preserves proof/state.
Bound released-refusal proof with collision-safe session/key tuples; include its iteration/cleanup in alpha/alpha:beta production controls.

A received definitive4xx status retains status origin even when its bounded error-body read fails/overflows;5xx remains protected uncertainty. Acknowledgement2xx body failure follows O-b. Add distinct status/body controls, no raw diagnostic authority or automatic retry.

Preserve existing released-refusal behavior: an explicit retry may supply a newly detached immutable body after a proven definitive refusal. Cached denial/malformed2xx/uncertainty still retain their original protected result regardless of replacement body. Never dispatch against an authoritative shared provisional rejection. This is not permission for automatic mutation replay.

Core R4 controls are stated in SL-2 test tasks; O-a..i remain explicitly referenced lane-owned requirements. The proposed persistence refinement is assigned to docs/omnigent-contract.md in SL-4 and canonical_spec_update closeout, pending full plan review.

Durable cross-process idempotency remains INTEG. It never waives current rejection/fence guarantees: no shared tombstone deletion in this variant, and any authoritative provisional tombstone blocks same-key effects. Process-local proof loss is documented; no new fence schema or durable idempotency claim.
